subject.title: feat(ui): hold-to-record dictation on the composer mic button

question: Should hold-to-record dictation be enabled by default for existing web users, with only a device-local opt-out?
rationale: This is a new user-facing interaction and persisted preference on an existing microphone control; automated review cannot choose the intended rollout default.

options.title: Approve default-on rollout
